title: What The New York Times looks for in AI licensing partnerships
description: The New York Times is seeing a more publisher-friendly AI licensing ecosystem, but the marketplaces still have a long way to go.

title: Amazon blocks Meta’s AI shopper
description: The e-commerce giant said Meta had failed to notify it about the Muse agent accessing its retail site to make purchases on behalf of consumers.

title: Amazon asks Meta to remove it from the Muse AI agent experience
description: The e-commerce giant — which is no stranger to the opt-out approach of agentic purchases — said it was not given advance notice Muse would access its shop.

description: The toy retailer is expanding its online presence via the e-commerce giant and will feature an Amazon pop-up shop at its flagship store in Rockefeller Center.

title: Hills Distribution adds PexUniverse for HVAC ecommerce expansion
description:
Hills Distribution and PexUniverse have announced a partnership, expanding each company’s role in distributing parts in the heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) space. Hills Distribution describes itself as a platform of independent plumbing, HVAC and hydronic distributors. PexUniverse describes itself as an ecommerce distributor for plumbing, heating and HVAC parts and supplies. Hills Distribution […]

title: La Joya Jewelry navigates channels, rising costs in its fulfillment
description:
As a retailer with high-value products, La Joya Jewelry is in a fortunate situation to be able to weather changes in fulfillment costs, according to founder Nishit Mehta. La Joya sells exclusively online, through a mix of its direct-to-consumer (DTC) website and through Amazon and Walmart’s marketplaces. Founded in 2020, the retailer sells lab-grown diamonds […]

title: Trane Technologies adds AI tools for repairs and part replacements
description:
Trane Technologies is expanding its artificial intelligence (AI) offerings for building owners and facilities teams, including a new maintenance platform designed to centralize equipment records and maintenance workflows and help inform repair and replacement decisions.
